Context: 10. Retention of Accommodation

-Rule 42.  
Retention granted on posting to non-family stations.Retention granted to allottees (including AGMUT cadre officers) of GPRA at their last place of posting in case of their posting to different non-family stations for bona fide use of their family members under different guidelines of Government of India issued from time to time, will be restricted to a maximum of three years.
